messages:
sarah: Quick sync — FinCorp asked for project-scoped API keys with rotation, per-project billing, and scoped permissions. They want a beta in ~6w. Can we scope this and call out major risks?
raj: Ok, high level: header semantics + auth lookup path + caching. We need to decide how keys map to projects and whether requests can omit project header (fallback to org). Also batching/cache key impacts.
maria: Product needs: console UX for creating/rotating keys, scopes (completions, embeddings, rerank, tool-calls, structured-output), and role model (org-admin, project-admin, project-reader). Docs + migration guide required.
ken: Security notes: rotation story is critical. Support immediate revoke, rotation via API, audit logs for key lifecycle, and guidance on short-lived tokens. Also need threat model for leaked project keys vs org keys.
alex: Infra impact: per-request key->project lookup adds a datastore read on auth path. We'll add a local LRU cache with TTL to avoid p95 regressions. For immediate revoke we need pubsub invalidation or versioned keys. Also need request logging to include project_id for billing.
sarah: Proposed API surface: keep existing header name for compatibility: `x-redwood-api-key`. Add optional `x-redwood-project` header; if present validate the key is scoped to that project. If absent, treat as org-level key (existing behavior). Example: 
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Headers:
  x-redwood-api-key: sk-live-xxxx
  x-redwood-project: proj_1234
Body: {"model":"rw-english-1","messages":[...]}
```
raj: For request routing & batching: if a project-scoped key maps to a model variant or dedicated pool, routing must consider project metadata. That could complicate batching across projects if we want strict isolation. MVP: allow co-located batching but enforce tenant quotas/limits at admission time.
maria: Launch checklist (MVP):
  - API auth checks for project keys (backend)
  - Console: create/label/rotate/revoke keys (basic)
  - Usage logs include project_id + key_id for billing
  - Audit events for create/rotate/revoke
  - Docs + migration guide + API examples
  - 2 beta customers onboarded (FinCorp + one internal)
  - Perf tests for auth lookup + cache invalidation
ken: Rotation strategy suggestion: support two modes — overlapping rotation (old key valid for short grace window) and immediate revoke. Provide an API to rotate and to exchange a project key for a short-lived session token (phase 2). Also surface last-rotated timestamp in key metadata.
alex: Timeline estimate: infra auth changes 3w, cache/invalidation 1w, console UI 2w, QA/integration 1w => ~7w. If we deprioritize session exchange we can do 6w but risky.
sarah: Prioritization notes: enterprise demand + narrow scope (auth+console+logs) => high impact. Confidence medium. Recommend green-light for beta but block GA until audit logs + rotation API present.
sec-bot: Policy draft created: /policies/auth/granular-keys-v1 — please review and ack.
maria: Action items:
  - raj: write spec + behavioral tests by Mon EOD
  - ken: draft rotation & revoke flows + threat model by Tue
  - alex: design cache + invalidation pubsub; perf targets by Tue
  - sarah: draft beta invite + onboarding checklist, confirm FinCorp timeline
  - sec-bot: attach policy link to spec when ready
raj: I'll include examples for tool-calls and embeddings to make sure scopes are explicit (e.g., `scope: ["completions","embeddings"]`).
sarah: Great. Schedule a spec review Wed 10am. :thumbsup:
